proof_body:
by
  intro A _ S I
  let f : S →+* A ⧸ I := (Ideal.Quotient.mk I).comp S.subtype
  have hk : RingHom.ker f = I.comap S.subtype := by
    ext x
    simp [f, RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have hr : f.range = S.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
    ext y
    simp [f, RingHom.mem_range, Subring.mem_map]
  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hk.symm).trans ((RingHom.quotientKerEquivRange f).trans (RingEquiv.subringCongr hr))⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (S : Subring A) (I : Ideal A), Nonempty ((S ⧸ I.comap S.subtype) ≃+* (S.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
